Definitions and Administration

Definitions

1 (1) In this Act, “warranty” means a promise made by a vendor.

(2) A promise includes an implied promise.

Compensation

2. The Corporation shall pay compensation out of the guarantee fund.

2020, c. 1, s. 1.

Protections

3 (1) A buyer who suffers damage is protected under this Act.

(2) The protection extends to a subsequent owner.

Note: transitional rules applied before 2021.

4 Payments under section 2 must be made within 30 days of the decision.
